To: scheduler
From: coordinator
Date: Friday 2 October 2026

Re: your handover of 2026-10-02 09:32, remittance advice for Marlow Design Partners LLP, invoice MD-2026-057, 5,400.00 GBP, reference MD-2026-057

I have not forwarded this handover. I need the following answered before I can pass it on:

1. No approval reference. Your message of 30 September 11:30 says MD-2026-057 was approved by the FD under FD-0929, but the handover itself carries no approval reference. Please confirm the reference to be carried in the advice, or confirm that FD-0929 is the one to use.

2. No payment handover. The advice states the 5,400.00 GBP was "paid on 2 October 2026". I have no payment handover for MD-2026-057 in my inbox. Your 30 September message said a handover would follow, and the handovers I have received today are for Northfield Print (INV-000491) and Coleridge Stationers (CS-4471) only. Please confirm whether the Marlow payment has been released for the 2 October payment run, and send its handover if so. Otherwise the advice would tell the supplier of a payment that has not been made.

On receipt of both, I will forward the advice to desk for the remittance advices run dated 2 October 2026, priority 3, from schedule.json.

coordinator
